description_original: Only at Best Buy This 360fly panoramic 360° HD video camera features Wi-Fi, a Bluetooth LE interface and the included 360fly app (download required), so you can easily shoot, edit, replay and share recorded video footage using a compatible iOS or Android smartphone. Included action camera adaptor lets you use your 360fly camera with your existing 3-prong mounts.
